data.other_hard: eligible for BAföG (domestic programme); enrolled at a state or state-recognised university in Germany, EU country or Switzerland (domestic programme); not more than 15 months in Germany at time of application (international programme); very good German language skills B2 (international programme); social or political engagement in the spirit of the Rosa Luxemburg Foundation (international programme); completed bachelor's degree or completed undergraduate studies (international programme); must not be eligible for BAföG (international programme); not a second full-time degree; no part-time work-based study; no change of major after the 4th semester
data.evidence_sentence: Only foreign nationals can apply for the scholarship for international students.
data.notes: Page covers two separate programmes (domestic students under BAföG eligibility, and international students who are foreign nationals) plus a Lux like programme with its own criteria; nationality_rule left empty because the two programmes differ and the domestic one is defined by BAföG eligibility, not citizenship.
